fib: ______ is any area on the earth's surface consisting of organisms interacting with one another and with the physical environment.
An ecosystem is any area on the earth's surface consisting of organisms interacting with one another and with the physical environment.
______ are the most dangerous because they almost always result in compound hazards (Hewitt and Burton, 1971).
Coastal floods are the most dangerous because they almost always result in compound hazards (Hewitt and Burton, 1971).
______ refers to non-cultural and non-social environment before the advent of man on earth.
The natural environment refers to non-cultural and non-social environment before the advent of man on earth.
______ are the least industrialized countries in the Eastern bloc, but this has not spared them.
Bulgaria and Romania are the least industrialized countries in the Eastern bloc, but this has not spared them.
______ are known to counteract or model warming effect of CO2.
Aerosols are known to counteract or model warming effect of CO2.
______ is the only element which occurs naturally in three states - gaseous, liquid and solid state.
Water is the only element which occurs naturally in three states - gaseous, liquid and solid state.
